title: globularia liouvillei subsp. greuteri
intro:
Globularia liouvillei subsp. greuteri, commonly known as the Corsican globe-flower, is a perennial herbaceous plant native to the Mediterranean region. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Globularia liouvillei subsp. greuteri include wound healing, anti-oxidant activity, and protection against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents responsible for its properties are flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
